RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel is a known risk factor for implicit bias, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination. For a laboratory head role, broad leadership experience and management training often carry significant weight alongside or above technical degrees.

Do not raise gender bias immediately, as doing so without documentation may harm your professional standing. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your overdue written feedback. Raising the panel's composition makes sense only if the feedback reveals subjective or inconsistent criteria, if hospital policy explicitly mandates gender-diverse interview panels, or if you decide to file a formal grievance after consulting an employment specialist.
